environment: Windows, in-app browser, isolated loopback node, synthetic source-created conversation conflicts

steps.action: Open discard review for a deleted synthetic conversation
steps.observed: Review receives focus, identifies the conversation and branch count, and explains independent-copy and remote-deletion limits

steps.action: Tab twice and Enter to keep recovery for now
steps.observed: No deletion; recovery remains and focus returns to its button

steps.action: Reopen review and confirm with Tab and Enter
steps.observed: Deleted conversation recovery leaves the list; focused status confirms local persistence only

steps.action: Stop and restart the node with its original data directory, reload Ask Ryn
steps.observed: Discarded recovery stays absent; unrelated live conversation branches remain

steps.action: Open the previously kept independent copy
steps.observed: Original provider and messages remain readable without a model

limits: Source seeding uses synthetic stores, not this run's device-pairing or network-delivery flow
Not packaged desktop, physical-device, cross-NAT or complete personal-data-erasure acceptance
Stale review, response loss, pending tasks, disk failure and old-message replay are automated checks rather than browser-injected failures
cleanup: Temporary browser tab closed and node process stopped; isolated data directory retained
